name: .224 Cal-35gr Hammer Hunter®
note: Recommended use: Small to Medium game hunting, up to deer. The product page also says: "Just think about running mid 4000’s fps with some of the bigger 22 cal cartridges! This Hammer Bullet will make red mist out of varmints yet hold together for larger game like deer. Speed Kills!"
